title: Initialization of the Counting Run
statement: Let $E,B\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a finite bit string, let $\mathcal{O}$ assign a Boolean answer to each of four query types and each bit string, and let $Q$ be a proposition. Suppose that for every $k\le |x|$, the answer to query type $0$ on the encoding of $x$ with the binary representation of $k$ is true exactly when $k<|x|$. Suppose also that $2^{\operatorname{size}(|x|)+1}\le B$. If, from the initial round state with the logarithm register set to $\operatorname{size}(|x|)+1$ and all other registers zero, every sequence of choices terminates while every register stays at most $B$, and the machine accepts exactly when $Q$ holds, then the same properties hold from the initial scan state with all registers zero.
hypotheses_covered: Oracle type 0 answers correctly for every k at most the input length
The initial round configuration has the specified logarithm register and all other registers zero
The run satisfies the termination, register-bound, and acceptance condition Q
replaced:
Let $E,B\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a finite bit string, let $Q$ be a proposition, and
let $\mathcal{O}$ assign a Boolean answer to each of four query types and each bit
string. Suppose that for every natural number $k\le |x|$, the answer to a query of type
$0$ on the encoding of $x$ together with the binary representation of $k$ is true
exactly when $k<|x|$. Suppose also that $2^{\operatorname{size}(|x|)+1}\le B$. If the
program terminates on every sequence of choices from its initial round state, with its
logarithm register set to $\operatorname{size}(|x|)+1$ and all other registers zero,
while keeping every register at most $B$, and accepts exactly when $Q$ holds, then it
has these same termination, register-bound, and acceptance properties from its initial
scan state with all registers zero.
